title: Probability of not halting
statement: For a function $r$ from finite Boolean strings to optional values and a natural number $t$, the probability of not halting by time $t$ is the fraction of length-$t$ Boolean strings $w$ for which $r(w)$ has no value, under the uniform distribution on those strings.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ maps finite Boolean strings to optional values
